# Changelog

## 1.1

Chords and scales, and a keyboard to see what you heard.

- Chord training: major, minor, diminished, augmented, sus4, and the 7ths,
  played as arpeggios across 8 levels
- Scale training: major, natural and harmonic minor, Dorian, Mixolydian, both
  pentatonics, blues and whole tone, across 8 levels
- A two-octave keyboard now lights up the notes that were played, on both the
  teaching screen and after every answer
- Teaching screens rebuilt around that keyboard, with a character note for
  every chord and scale
- Progress bar during a quiz, and answers centred on screen
- Answer grid adapts its columns to the length of the names
- Existing progress and stats carry over from 1.0

## 1.0

First release.

- 13 levels, from octaves and fifths through to the tritone
- Ascending, Descending and Mixed modes, each with its own progress
- Teaching screen for every new interval, with a tune that opens with it
- Mix levels that review everything learned so far, with three lives
- Interval reference screen that plays any of the thirteen on demand
- Hints, stars, streaks and lifetime accuracy stats
- Settings for note length, fixed or random root, tune hints, vibro and LED
